episode_summary: Anna Kara, a top mortgage producer, shares insights on navigating high mortgage rates, managing self-employed borrowers, and building a strong personal brand. She emphasizes the importance of client education and authenticity in branding, while also providing tactical advice for leveraging existing assets and exploring diverse loan products.
